result.summary: The layout is largely intact, but the 'Fastest near you' carousel contains a duplicated restaurant entry, and the favorite (heart) button styling is inconsistent between the two 'Popular right now' cards, with the second one having poor contrast against a dark image.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' carousel shows 'Green Bowl Poké' twice in a row — identical image, delivery time (15–25 min) and delivery fee (€0.90) — which looks like a duplicated data entry rather than two distinct venues.
issues.suggestion: De-duplicate the restaurant list by unique ID before rendering the carousel, or differentiate the entries (e.g. distinct branch names/addresses) if they are genuinely separate locations.

issues.description: The favorite heart buttons on the two 'Popular right now' cards use different styles: the first is a white circle with a dark outlined heart, the second is a dark/transparent circle with a white heart, giving low contrast against the bright pizza image.
issues.suggestion: Use one consistent favorite button treatment (e.g. white circular background with dark heart outline plus a subtle shadow) across all cards to ensure visibility on any image.

issues.description: The 'Popular right now' section only shows the image portion of the second (pizza) card before the list is cut, and no restaurant name/rating row is visible for it, making the section feel unbalanced compared to the fully rendered first card.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the card metadata block renders together with the image so partially scrolled cards still read as complete units, and verify bottom padding above the tab bar.
